VP SARA’S SALN UNDER FIRE OVER 'UNDECLARED WEALTH'

Manila 6th District Rep. Benny Abante claimed that their review of Vice President Sara Duterte’s Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALNs) since her time as mayor indicates alleged discrepancies, suggesting the presence of wealth not fully disclosed.

He also alleged that he and his colleagues identified multiple companies linked to Duterte and her spouse, some of which appear to be operating, though he declined to disclose the sources of their documents.

More on this in the full episode of #TheSpokes.
